messages:
nic: heads-up — getting brief ECC/Xid flashes reported by dcgm-exporter across a small cohort in eu-west1. ~3 nodes, different racks. started ~09:12 UTC

sanjay: saw the grafana spike, looks like exporter sample jitter right after the driver patch rolled yesterday. short 10–30s blips, not sustained ops impact yet.

elyse: can you paste the raw exporter logs? curious if it's exporter churn or telemetry sampling rate change.

nic: logs attached below (trimmed). pattern: exporter restarts or telemetry write timeout, then bunch of dcgm metrics jump briefly.

nic: ```
2026-03-18T09:12:14Z dcgm-exporter[2378]: sample loop took 345ms (threshold 200ms)
2026-03-18T09:12:14Z dcgm-exporter[2378]: reconnecting to DCGM: rpc deadline exceeded
2026-03-18T09:12:15Z dcgm-exporter[2378]: emit dcgm_ecc_count_total{card="gpu-2",node="gpunode-17"} 1
```

kai: thanks. pattern matches a sample-rate jitter where we briefly miss async probes and counts pop. Prom rules are currently pretty sensitive — lots of alerts use increase(...[1m]) > 0 with for: 0m or 1m.

elyse: proposed short-term: add 5–10m for: on ECC/Xid alerts to avoid flapping. long-term: compute a sustained-rate recording rule and alert on sustained error rate > threshold for 10m.

nic: agree. we should avoid mass drains for these short transients. can we push a quick promrule patch and silence the noisy alerts while we validate?

oncall-bot: Incident alert: GPU_ECC_Spike fired on eu-west1/gpunode-17 at 2026-03-18T09:13:05Z (severity: warning)

elyse: I'll open a small PR with two changes: 1) change existing alert for ECC spikes to for: 5m and add label cluster="eu-west1"; 2) add recording rule gpu:ecc:rate1m = increase(dcgm_ecc_count_total[1m]) / 1m and gpu:ecc:rate5m = increase(dcgm_ecc_count_total[5m]) / 5m, then alert on gpu:ecc:rate5m > 0.1 with for: 10m.

nic: sounds good. include an annotation with runbook link and node-cohort to avoid paging for low-usage GPU pools.

kai: temporary step: call alertmanager silence for the specific alerts from 09:10–09:40 UTC to suppress noise while patch rolls out: `amtool silence add -m "transient exporter jitter" "alertname=GPU_ECC_Spike,region=eu-west1" 2026-03-18T09:10:00Z 2026-03-18T09:40:00Z`

elyse: will draft the PR now, targeting canary config and then prod. I'll also add a note to the runbook: check exporter uptime + driver version and whether the patch changed probe timing.

nic: FYI cost note — if we start auto-draining on these short transients, it triggers unnecessary node replacements that tank capacity and rack-level utilization. want to avoid that.

deploy-bot: CI job passed for pr #4922 (prometheus/rules): gpu-ecc-rate-recordings + for:5m patch. staging apply queued.

nic: after staging applies, monitor the grafana panel for 30m. if still noisy we schedule a driver rollback in the maintenance window.

elyse: staged to staging, will watch. thanks all :thumbsup:
